question:
Which constructor scored most points from Monaco Grand Prix between 1980 and 2010? List the score, name and nationality of this team.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Monaco Grand Priz refers to the race; race in year between 1980 and 2010

prediction.sql: SELECT SUM(cr.XCL_013) AS score, c.XCL_024 AS name, c.XCL_025 AS nationality FROM constructorResults AS "cr" JOIN races AS "r" ON "cr".XCL_011 = "r".XCL_065 JOIN constructors AS "c" ON "cr".XCL_012 = "c".XCL_022 WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY cr.XCL_012, c.XCL_024, c.XCL_025 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

arguments.sql:
SELECT SUM(cr.XCL_013) AS score, c.XCL_024 AS name, c.XCL_025 AS nationality
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.XCL_011 = r.XCL_065
JOIN constructors c ON cr.XCL_012 = c.XCL_022
WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY cr.XCL_012, c.XCL_024, c.XCL_025
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;
